label: rem:ns-obstruction-tower-summary
title: The NS obstruction as a local-cohomology residue
html:
The NS obstruction is measured across the levels of the brane tower by restricting \kappa_n to the collision locus \Sigma. The proposition, conditional on the conjectures named in its banner, reads a non-zero restriction as NS-singular and a vanishing one as NS-regular. As its proof notes, \Sigma is one-dimensional, so H^2(\Sigma, \cdot) = 0 and the criterion as stated does not discriminate.

Survival of \kappa_n|_\Sigma cannot be identified with Levi non-degeneracy or with a bounded core aspect ratio: the Levi datum of the vorticity plane field is the single scalar \xi\cdot\mathrm{curl}\,\xi, the core aspect ratio is not a Levi quantity, and no result connects the Levi degeneracy conjecture on \xi\cdot\mathrm{curl}\,\xi over the high-vorticity set to \kappa_n|_\Sigma.
